page.overview:
Who is Asgaarth?

Asgaarth is a non-canon character from the cartoon Mortal Kombat: Defenders of the Realm. He appears as a member of an Eagle-like race of humanoids that are originally from Edenia.

Asgaarth was a wise advisor and general of King Jerrod. After Jerrod's death at the hands of Shao Kahn, Asgaarth went into hiding, but he secretly remained in contact with Princess Kitana, Jerrod‘s daughter, whom he served as one of her main advisors during her plotting of rebellion.
